run_f_gold: run f_gold to turn off the k-th bit in integer n using bitwise operations
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the provided parameter sets in the main block
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to handle negative k values or add input validation for n and k
review_f_gold: review f_gold which uses n & ~(1 << (k-1)) to clear the k-th bit in number n
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold a function that turns off a particular bit at position k in integer n
